metadata.title: Molecula — AI Creative Production Operating System
metadata.description: Molecula is a connected creative production platform for AI images, video, film, music, voice, scripts, characters, and worlds — taking a project from idea to finished export in one place.

footer.statement: One connected system for AI creative production — from first idea to finished export.

headline: Create.
Direct. Produce.
hero.subhead: Molecula is a connected creative production platform for producing images, video, film, music, voice, characters, and worlds — as one continuous project, not a pile of disconnected tools.

visual.ariaLabel: Molecula's connected production system: Idea at the center, linked to Image, Video, Film, Music, Voice, and 3D.

positioning.statement: Molecula doesn't generate isolated assets. It produces one connected project.
positioning.body: Every stage — script, characters, visuals, sound, edit — stays linked to the same creative direction, so nothing has to be reinvented scene to scene, asset to asset.

productSystem.heading: One idea, carried through every layer
productSystem.description: A Molecula project starts as a single idea and branches through direction and DNA into every medium it needs — without losing the thread back to where it started.

connectedStudios.heading: Five specialist studios. One shared creative brain.
connectedStudios.description: Image, Video, Music, Voice, and 3D each get a dedicated studio — but every one of them reads from the same project direction, characters, and continuity.

examples.example: A keyframe generated from the project's own Visual DNA and character references.
A shot rendered with the continuity already locked in from earlier scenes.
A score cue written to the scene's pacing and mood, not a generic loop.
A character's voice held consistent across every take and language.
A previs environment reused as the lighting reference for the final shot.

continuity.heading: Every asset checked against what came before it
continuity.description: Continuity AI compares each new generation against the project's established characters, environments, and direction — flagging drift before it reaches the final edit.

autoDirector.heading: AI direction that keeps shots intentional
autoDirector.description: Auto Director proposes shot coverage, pacing, and framing from the scene's script and Visual DNA — a starting cut a human director refines, not a black box.
notes: Establishing wide — sets the space before any character enters.
Coverage shifts to a medium two-shot as the dialogue starts.
Cut to a close-up on the reaction beat, held for pacing.
Return to the wide to close the scene on the same axis it opened.

autoEdit.heading: Assembly-first editing, built on the project's own direction
autoEdit.description: Auto Edit assembles video, voice, and music into a synchronized first cut — respecting the pacing Auto Director already set, not guessing at it from scratch.
capabilities: Cuts synced to dialogue and music beats
Automatic pacing from the Auto Director shot list
Multi-track assembly across video, voice, and music
A first cut ready for human refinement, not a final export

meta.title: Security
meta.description: Molecula's current technical foundation and the production security architecture it's designed to grow into.

hero.heading: Built on a secure foundation, designed for production scale
hero.description: Below is a clear separation between what's implemented today and the production controls Molecula's architecture is designed for.

items.title: Validated environment configuration
items.description: Environment variables are validated with Zod before any client is created, rather than trusted implicitly.

items.title: No secrets exposed to the client
items.description: Server-only credentials never ship in client-side code or get committed to source control.

items.title: Server-first rendering
items.description: Pages render as Server Components by default, in a strict-mode TypeScript codebase.

items.title: Supabase wired for server and browser
items.description: Server and browser Supabase clients are in place, each built for its own request context.

planned.heading: What the architecture is designed for

items.title: Row Level Security on every table
items.description: Designed for RLS policies enforced on all Supabase tables handling project or account data.

items.title: Private, signed asset access
items.description: Architecture plans for generated assets served through signed, time-limited URLs rather than public storage.

items.title: Team and workspace permissions
items.description: Production roadmap includes role-based access for teams working on shared projects.

items.title: Voice consent and rights verification
items.description: Designed for a consent and rights-verification step before any character voice can be cloned or reused.

items.title: Audit logging
items.description: Architecture plans for an audit trail covering generation activity and account-level changes.

items.title: Secure generation workflows
items.description: Production roadmap includes end-to-end secured upload, generation, and storage paths for project assets.

finalCta.heading: Questions about enterprise security?
finalCta.description: This page will grow alongside the production architecture it describes.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Molecula's product philosophy — why AI creation is fragmented today, and what it means to preserve creative context across a project.

hero.heading: Idea to world, without losing the thread

philosophy.body: Every tool generates in isolation — a character that resets between images, a voice that drifts between takes, a scene that forgets what came before it. Molecula's goal is to preserve creative context, so a project stays one continuous thing from idea to finished world.

lines: The image should know the character.
The video should know the scene.
The music should know the story.
The edit should know the film.
